title: Event Schema Evolution
description: Handle event versioning and backward compatibility.

data.text: Event schemas evolve over time. You must handle schema changes without breaking existing consumers. Backward and forward compatibility are key.

terms.definition: New consumers can read old events.
Old consumers can read new events.
A registry of event schemas and versions.

data.text: A schema registry stores event schemas and validates compatibility. Confluent Schema Registry is popular with Kafka. It supports Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema.

items: Parallel versions: publish v1 and v2
Upcasters: transform old events to new format

flowchart TD

    Reg -->|Validate| Consumer2[Consumer v2]
    Consumer1 -->|Reads v2| OK1[Compatible]
    Consumer2 -->|Reads v1| OK2[Compatible]
